description: This Java source file defines the ExpressCheckoutEvents class, which manages PayPal Express Checkout processes within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting up checkout, redirecting to PayPal, updating checkout details, retrieving checkout info, executing the checkout, and canceling. It also determines checkout type based on payment settings.

classes.name: ExpressCheckoutEvents
classes.description: Class managing PayPal Express Checkout operations including setup, redirect, update, retrieval, execution, and cancellation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initializes the Express Checkout process by calling the appropriate PayPal service based on checkout type.

methods.name: expressCheckoutRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to PayPal's Express Checkout page using the stored checkout token.

methods.name: expressCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates the checkout details via PayPal service for standard checkout type.

methods.name: getExpressCheckoutDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of the Express Checkout from PayPal.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Executes the actual Express Checkout process, calling the appropriate service.

methods.name: expressCheckoutCancel
methods.description: Cancels the checkout by removing the PayPal token from the shopping cart.

methods.name: determineCheckoutType
methods.description: Determines the checkout type (PAYFLOW, STANDARD, NONE) based on payment settings.
